invented.quote: That is about one day in every eight.
invented.why: The brief does not state the current date, so the number of days elapsed in the year cannot be known to calculate the ratio of 41 out-of-service days.

invented.quote: That was five months ago, and residents are still waiting.
invented.why: The brief mentions events in June, August, and September, but does not state that the current month is November or that five months have passed since June.

invented.quote: That is two out of every three households in the building.
invented.why: The brief states the building has 112 apartments, not that all 112 apartments are occupied by households.

invented.quote: It would tell 112 households when they can count on their elevator again.
invented.why: The brief states the building has 112 apartments, not that there are 112 occupied households in the building.
